options.name: active
options.description: True if the proxy is active.

options.name: api_headers
options.description: Headers that are passed to the socketio connection.

options.name: api_password
options.description: The Uptime Kuma password. Only required if no I(api_token) specified and authentication is enabled.

options.name: api_ssl_verify
options.description: true to verify SSL certificates, or false to skip SSL certificate verification, allowing connections to servers with self signed certificates.

options.name: api_timeout
options.description: How many seconds the client should wait for the connection, an expected event or a server response.

options.name: api_token
options.description: The Uptime Kuma login token. Only required if no I(api_username) and I(api_password) specified and authentication is enabled.

options.name: api_username
options.description: The Uptime Kuma username. Only required if no I(api_token) specified and authentication is enabled.

options.name: api_wait_events
options.description: How many seconds the client should wait for the next event of the same type. There is no way to determine when the last message of a certain type has arrived. Therefore, a timeout is required. If no further message has arrived within this time, it is assumed that it was the last message.

options.name: applyExisting
options.description: True if the proxy is applied to existing monitors.

options.name: auth
options.description: True if the authentication is enabled.

options.name: default
options.description: True if the proxy is the default.

options.name: host
options.description: The host of the proxy. Only required if no I(id) specified.

options.name: id
options.description: The id of the proxy. Only required if no I(host), I(port) and I(protocol) specified.

options.name: port
options.description: The port of the proxy. Only required if no I(id) specified.

options.name: state
options.description: Set to C(present) to create/update a proxy. Set to C(absent) to delete a proxy.
